cases.name: one-container-operations-hardening

files.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: app:1
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 1
              memory: 256Mi
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /ready
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /live
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true

cases.tradeoff: All L3 signals must belong to one workload container; this is authored-manifest depth, not rollout/runtime proof.

cases.name: signals-split-across-containers

files.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: sized
          image: app:1
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
        - name: probed
          image: app:1
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /ready
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /live
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true

cases.tradeoff: Resources in one container cannot lend evidence to probes/security in another.

cases.name: non-workload-object

files.k8s/configmap.yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: settings
data:
  mode: prod

cases.tradeoff: A valid non-workload Kubernetes object proves manifest identity only; it does not provide workload or container-depth evidence.

cases.name: block-scalar-lookalike

files.k8s/config.yaml:
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  sample: |
    kind: Deployment
    containers:
      readinessProbe: {}

cases.tradeoff: Keys inside a YAML block scalar are content rather than Kubernetes workload structure.
